title: SignalRef field extraction answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for a signal reference (sort_signal, control_axis). The model picks ONE concept id from the injected Signal Concept Registry menu, or the first-class escape 'unrecognised' (D22: exact + binary, no similarity). It returns the paper's own label + at least one verbatim quote. Registry membership and the unrecognised escape invariant are enforced by validate_librarian_spec.

concept_id.description: A registry concept id, or 'unrecognised'; null when answered=false.

label.description: The paper's own words for the signal (audit-only).

quote.description: Verbatim span supporting the pick; required when answered=true.
